notes: 3D skating: quicker, cleaner hockey stops (hips turn first, snow spray on hard stops) and starts; defensemen skate backward at realistic speeds and pivot to forward when beaten, with backward crossovers; refs and linesmen skate and stop like real officials; shallower crouch in turns; skates stay on the ice in crossovers; no more turntable spins; smoother legs in crossovers and pivots; far players animate every frame when the game runs slower.
